title: Saqiye Kausar ki Sana
body:
Saqiye Kausar ki Sana
Saheb e Zulfikar Al Madadadain.....2
Kam Mushkil Hai To Imdada E Khuda Kardunga
Aaj Mai Ishk Ka Tufaan Bapa Kardunga
<<MINI>>
Karne Do Mujhe Saki E Kausar (As.) Ki Sana.....2
<<DIVIDER>>
Raz Allah (S.w.t.) Ki Tawheed Hai Hamraz  Ali (A.s.)
Kibriaai e Ki Dalilon Ka Hai Aagaz Ali (A.s.)
Dil Me Dil Se Jo Nikli Hai Woh Aawaz Ali (A.s.)
Aasma Saaz Zameen Saaz Bashar Shaaz Ali (A.s.)
Kare Takhllek Ba Taieed E Ahad Karta Hai
Yeh Woh Banda Hai Jo Khalik Ki Madad Karta Hai
<<MINI>>
Karne Do Mujhe Saki E Kausar (As.) Ki Sana.....2
<<DIVIDER>>
Mimbar E Aalaam e Imka Ka Khateeb E Azam
Bolta Tha To Thahar Jaate The Lamho Ke Kadam
Mera Is Baat Pe Iman Hai Quran Ki Kasam
Ladkhada Ta Na Jo Kamzarf Nusairi Us Dam
Apne Hubbe daron Ko Nabio Se Badha Dete Ali (A.s.)
Ek Ek Shaks Ko Salman Banadete Ali (A.s.)
<<MINI>>
Karne Do Mujhe Saki E Kausar (As.) Ki Sana.....2
<<DIVIDER>>
Wahi Jibril Bhi Laate The Yeh Eman Hai Mera
Is Ravish Par Bhi Zara Sochiea Aai Ahle Wila
Aage Sidrat Ke Farishta Yeh Nahi Jaa Sakta
Phir Yeh Quran Bhala Kiski Badaulat Pahucha
Lafz Allah (S.w.t.) Maula Mere Ban Jaate The
Jo Ali (A.s.) Kehte The Jibril Wahi Late The.
<<MINI>>
Karne Do Mujhe Saki E Kausar (As.) Ki Sana.....2
<<DIVIDER>>
Jiski Marzi Hai Mukada, Woh Sikandar Hai Ali (A.s.)
Jis Se Sadir Hue Masoom Woh Mazhar Hai Ali (A.s.)
Jiska Mehkoom Hai Kauthar Woh Samandar Hai Ali (A.s.)
Jo Hai Tauheed Ka Izhar Woh Mazhar Hai Ali (a.s.)
Jo Bhi Parda Shabe Meraj Ka Sarka E Ga
Usko Allah (S.w.t.) Nahi Haidar (A.s.) Hi Nazar Aaienga
<<MINI>>
Karne Do Mujhe Saki E Kausar (As.) Ki Sana.....2
<<DIVIDER>>
Aai Azadaron Humein Phir Se Sambhal Na Honga
Apne Kirdar Se Mahol Badalna Honga
Todkar Wakt Ki Zanzeer Nikalna Honga
Rahe Salman Pe Eman Se Chalna Honga
Hum Muhibbo Pe Jo Wa Zulm Ka Darwaza Hai
Yeh Ali (A.s.) Ko Na Samajhne Ka Hi Khamyaza Hai
<<MINI>>
Karne Do Mujhe Saki E Kausar (As.) Ki Sana.....2
<<DIVIDER>>
Madh E Haider (A.s.) Me Takallum Yeh Taqaiya Kaisa
Maslehat Kaisi, Ana Kaisi, Bahana Kaisa
Aur Wakt Ke Sath Aqeade Ko Badalna Kaisa
Maut Aani Hai To Phir Maut Se Khatra Kaisa
Band Yeh Ishk Ka Darwaza Nahi Kar Sakta
Mai Ali (A.s.) Par Koi Samjhauta Nahi Karsakta
<<MINI>>
Karne Do Mujhe Saki E Kausar (As.) Ki Sana.....2
